correctness.rationale: For P(z)=z^F+sum_{g<F,g gap} c_g z^g, the reciprocal derivative D(t)=t^(F-1)P prime(1/t)/F=1+U(t) has zeros encoded as product (1-r_j t). Newton logarithm gives power sums of critical points including multiplicity, hence trace=-F[t^F]D(t)log D(t). Multinomial expansion yields every noncancelling monomial with weighted degree F. Second derivative yields anti-diagonal Hessian entries -gh/F when g+h=F; no pair of complementary semigroup elements can both be in S since F is a gap. Summing gap indicators gives rank 2*genus-F-1 and the real 2x2 sign blocks yield inertia. Additive semigroup closure forces zero trace if symmetric; for pseudo-symmetry only central h+h contributes, giving -F*c_h^2/8. F=1 empty case explicitly holds. Independently checked genus rank for multiple semigroups and evaluated exact rational traces by quotient-ring companion/multiplication matrices versus coefficient formula for ordinary F=6, pseudo F=6, and nonsymmetric F=5 examples.
